title: 第11章 闪云梭与幻形珠第12章 考核任务
lines: “道友想要一件飞行法器？这可真是找对地方了。”黄掌柜听到李卓阳有采买飞行法器的打算，当即便开始了推荐。
只见他从腰间一个镶嵌着金边的储物袋中，掏出了一只像是木制的小小飞鹤向李卓阳介绍道：
“这只白羽鹤乃是用凌空木与二阶妖兽千羽鹤的羽毛炼制而成的，是一件中品法器，每飞行百里仅需要消耗五枚下品灵石。”
说完，他向白羽鹤施展一道法诀，白羽鹤骤然变大了到一丈左右，在白羽鹤的脖颈之处，有一处凹槽，可以嵌入数块灵石。
“不知这白羽鹤飞行速度如何？”
“这……”黄掌柜说着老脸微红，“白羽鹤的优势是节省灵石，速度嘛，也颇为不俗。”
不俗，就是一般般喽。
李卓阳毕竟出身杂货铺，这些弦外之音还是能听得出来的。
他目前欠缺的就是速度，如果飞行法器太慢，那他宁愿自己跑步前行，别人肉身忍受不了辛苦，他可没问题。
黄掌柜眼光老辣，一眼就看出李卓阳对此物不感兴趣，便又拿出了一件船型法器道：
“这件法器名为逍遥舟，乃是一件上品飞行法器，此物飞行速度极快，只要灵石充足，速度可堪比筑基境初期修士的御剑飞行速度。”
“哦？果真如此快？”李卓阳一听便来了兴趣，堪比筑基境初期的御剑速度，那可真是不慢了。
“确实如此。”黄掌柜如刚才一样，施展出一道法术，逍遥舟骤然变成了长达十几丈的飞舟。
飞舟甲板上面还搭建了一栋二层楼阁，端的是宽敞大气。
李卓阳看一眼就非常喜欢，不过此飞舟如此之大，恐怕会耗费不少灵石。
“只是不知这逍遥舟耗费灵石如何？”李卓阳想到就问道。
“逍遥舟个体大，速度也快，就是稍微耗费灵石，每飞行百里大约需要五十块灵石。”
黄掌柜又连忙指着飞舟一处凹槽道：“不过道友不用担心频繁更换灵石会耽搁行程，这处凹槽每次都可容纳数百灵石，足够飞行上千里了。”
不过李卓阳担心的哪里是更换灵石的事儿，他是心疼那五十块灵石。
今天虽然刚入手了一万多块灵石，但自己身体就是一个无底洞，花灵石不能大手大脚。
“这飞舟有些太过招摇，有违长辈的命令。”李卓阳不好意思说用不起，只好将不存在的长辈搬出来背锅。
“原来如此，”接连两个推荐都被婉拒后，黄掌柜也不生气，反而越挫越勇。
“道友再看这个法器。”
说着，黄掌柜又掏出了一只飞梭状的法器。
“这只法器名为闪云梭，虽然也只是中品法器，但是其速度一点不逊于刚才的那间逍遥舟，甚至还会更快。”
黄掌柜如刚才一样打出法诀，闪云梭也瞬间长到了一丈左右长，但其宽度却比一人身体稍宽。
“这件闪云梭速度快，体型小，而且耗费灵石也极低，每百里仅需耗费八块灵石，想必可以满足道友的需要了。”
李卓阳对这件法器还是比较满意的。
“既然如此之快，为何只是中品法器？”李卓阳有些怀疑黄掌柜是不是在坑自己。
“道友有所不知，这法器炼制者只考虑了速度，没考虑到舒适性的问题。因其速度太快又无护罩，飞行时产生的罡风会让修士有些许不适。”
content_en:
"Fellow Taoist, you want a flying magic weapon? This is really the right place." Shopkeeper Huang heard that Li Zhuoyang was planning to buy a flying magic weapon and immediately started to recommend it.
He took out a small wooden flying crane from a storage bag inlaid with gold rim around his waist and introduced it to Li Zhuoyang:
"This white-feathered crane is made from the volleying wood and the feathers of the second-level monster Thousand-feathered Crane. It is a middle-grade magic weapon. It only consumes five low-grade spiritual stones for every hundred miles of flight."
After saying that, he cast a spell on Bai Yuhe, and Bai Yuhe suddenly grew in size to about one foot. There was a groove on Bai Yuhe's neck that could embed several spiritual stones.
"I wonder how fast this white-feathered crane flies?"
"This..." Shopkeeper Huang said with a blush on his face, "White Yuhe's advantage is that he can save spiritual stones, and his speed is also quite good."
Not bad, just so-so.
After all, Li Zhuoyang was born in a grocery store, so you can still hear these overtones.
What he currently lacks is speed. If the flying magic weapon is too slow, then he would rather run forward by himself. Others can't bear the hardship physically, but he has no problem.
Shopkeeper Huang had a sharp eye and could tell at a glance that Li Zhuoyang was not interested in this object, so he took out another boat-shaped magic weapon and said:
"This magical weapon is called Xiaoyao Zhou. It is a high-grade flying magical weapon. This object flies extremely fast. As long as there are enough spiritual stones, the speed can be compared to the flying speed of the sword of a monk in the early stage of the Foundation Establishment Realm."
"Oh? Is it really that fast?" Li Zhuoyang became interested as soon as he heard it. It was comparable to the speed of sword control in the early stage of the Foundation Establishment Realm. It was really not slow.
"It's true." Shopkeeper Huang cast a spell just like before, and the Xiaoyao boat suddenly turned into a flying boat more than ten feet long.
There is also a two-story pavilion built on the deck of the flying boat, which is spacious and atmospheric.
Li Zhuoyang liked it very much at first sight, but this flying boat was so big that it would probably cost a lot of spiritual stones.
"I just wonder how this Xiaoyao boat consumes spiritual stones?" Li Zhuoyang asked as he thought about it.
"Xiaoyao Zhou is big and fast, but it consumes a little bit of spiritual stones. It takes about fifty spiritual stones for every hundred miles of flight."
Shopkeeper Huang quickly pointed to a groove in the flying boat and said, "But Taoist friends don't have to worry about frequent replacement of spirit stones that will delay the journey. This groove can hold hundreds of spirit stones at a time, which is enough to fly thousands of miles."
However, Li Zhuoyang was not worried about replacing the spiritual stones. He was worried about the fifty spiritual stones.
Although I just bought more than 10,000 spiritual stones today, my body is like a bottomless pit, so I can't spend too much money on the spiritual stones.
"This flying boat is a little too ostentatious and goes against the orders of the elders." Li Zhuoyang was embarrassed to say that he couldn't afford it, so he had to take the blame for the non-existent elder.
"That's it." After two consecutive recommendations were declined, shopkeeper Huang was not angry, but became more frustrated and courageous.
"Fellow Taoist, look at this magic weapon again."
With that said, shopkeeper Huang took out another shuttle-shaped magic weapon.
"This magical weapon is called the Flashing Cloud Shuttle. Although it is only a middle-grade magical weapon, its speed is not inferior to the Xiaoyao Boat just now, and may even be faster."
Shopkeeper Huang played the magic formula as before, and the Shangyun Shuttle instantly grew to about ten feet long, but its width was slightly wider than a human body.
"This Flashing Cloud Shuttle is fast, small in size, and consumes very low spiritual stones. It only costs eight spiritual stones per hundred miles. It must be able to meet the needs of fellow Taoists."
Li Zhuoyang is quite satisfied with this magical weapon.
"If it's so fast, why is it only a medium-grade magic weapon?" Li Zhuoyang wondered if Shopkeeper Huang was trying to trick him.
"My fellow Taoists don't know that the refiner of this magical weapon only considered the speed and did not consider the issue of comfort. Because the speed is too fast and there is no shield, the strong wind generated during flight will make the monks feel a little uncomfortable."
